data.title: Claude is a [[toolkit]]
data.subtitle: Six tools in one app. Set each one up once, then pick the right one.

cards.title: Cowork
cards.text: Hand over a task with several steps. Come back to finished work.
cards.quote: Turn these notes into one Word report.

cards.title: The right model
cards.text: Opus 5.5 for most work. Sonnet 5.5 or Haiku 5.5 when speed matters.
cards.quote: Leave effort on Default to start.

cards.title: Claude for Excel
cards.text: Answers about your workbook that cite the cells. Keeps formulas intact.

cards.title: Plugins and skills
cards.text: Plugins set Claude up for your role. Skills do one job your way.
cards.quote: Type / to see what's switched on.

cards.title: Artifacts
cards.text: Docs, decks and dashboards that open beside the chat, ready to share.

cards.title: Projects
cards.text: One workspace per piece of work, with its own files and instructions.
